errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays the contact types: “Support of Authorities,” “Extended Contact,” “Virtual Contact,” “No Contact Before,” and “No Contact After,”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists items from the legend ("No Contact Before," and "No Contact After") as categories on the horizontal axis. The horizontal axis only shows three categories: "Support of Authorities," "Extended Contact," and "Virtual Contact".
The categories on the x-axis ("Support of Authorities," "Extended Contact," "Virtual Contact") are not arranged in alphabetical order.
The vertical axis shown in the figure ranges from 0 to 70, not 60.

errors.text_span: The tallest bar, representing “Positive Contact After” for “Support of Authorities,” has a value of 47.28%
errors.evidence: The tallest bar (value 47.28%) represents "Negative Contact Before" in the "Extended Contact" group. The value for "Positive Contact After" for "Support of Authorities" is 0.00.

errors.text_span: while the shortest bar, representing “Positive Contact After” for “Virtual Contact,” has a value of 0.04%.
errors.evidence: The shortest values are 0.00, not 0.04. The value for "Positive Contact After" for "Virtual Contact" is 10.01, not 0.04%. The value 0.04% corresponds to "No Contact After" for "Support of Authorities".

errors.text_span: with each bar divided into two sections representing “Negative Contact Before” (light blue) and “Positive Contact After” (red).
errors.evidence: This is a fundamental misrepresentation of the chart's structure. The chart has six categories in the legend, not two. It also fails to mention the striped pattern for 'After' conditions and that only the 'Virtual Contact' group has visibly stacked bars. It incorrectly maps colors and categories.

errors.text_span: All bars are sorted from left to right based on the contact type.
errors.evidence: This statement is vague and inaccurate. The primary grouping is by 'Support of Authorities,' 'Extended Contact,' and 'Virtual Contact.' Within each group, there is a consistent but not explicitly sorted order of sub-categories (No Contact, Positive Contact, Negative Contact).
The description completely misses the distinction between 'Before' (solid color) and 'After' (striped pattern) conditions, which is crucial for understanding the chart's purpose.

The description fails to mention that the bars in the 'Virtual Contact' group are stacked, while the bars in the other two groups are not visibly stacked in the same way. It also fails to mention that values are labeled directly on the bars.
